name: Avioane & Bărcuțe
author: DansiDanutz
summary: The old paper game. Hide two planes and three boats, then find the other player's first.

choices.label: Easy
choices.note: A miss right beside a piece is called near.

choices.label: Hard
choices.note: A miss is only a miss.

howto: Hide your planes and boats. Nobody can see them, not even the other computer.
Take turns shooting. A hit on the head brings a plane down; a boat sinks when every part is hit.
The first to bring down the whole fleet wins. The winner's fleet is checked at the end.
